laws.rule: Veuve Special Reserve, Anse Réunion, La Digue: entry is ticketed, with separate guided and unguided options. The reserve publishes Monday to Friday 08:00 to 16:00 and Saturday 09:00 to 15:00 visiting hours. Follow SPGA ranger instructions. Sunday hours are not stated on the page; do not assume Sunday access.
